info.name: ATCO Electric Hosting Capacity Feature Service

params.name: f
params.description: Response format. The service advertises supportedQueryFormats "JSON, geoJSON, PBF"; `html` and `pjson` are also served by ArcGIS REST.

items.docs: Returns the self-describing FeatureServer descriptor — currentVersion, serviceDescription, capabilities, maxRecordCount, spatial reference, full extent and the layer list.

info.name: Get hosting capacity feature layer metadata

params.name: f
params.description: Response format. The service advertises supportedQueryFormats "JSON, geoJSON, PBF"; `html` and `pjson` are also served by ArcGIS REST.

items.docs: Returns the layer 0 descriptor — field definitions, object id field, geometry type, extent, drawing info, advanced query capabilities and record-count limits.

params.name: where
params.description: A standardized SQL WHERE clause over the layer's fields (the layer sets `useStandardizedQueries: true`). Use `1=1` for all features.

params.name: objectIds
params.description: Comma-separated OBJECTID list. maxIdsCount is 1,000,000.

params.name: geometry
params.description: Spatial filter geometry, as JSON or comma-separated envelope/point coordinates.

params.name: inSR
params.description: Spatial reference of the input geometry. The layer's native spatial reference is wkid 102185 / latestWkid 3401 (NAD83 / Alberta 3TM ref merid 115 W).

params.name: spatialRel
params.description: Spatial relationship to apply. Values taken verbatim from the layer's `supportedSpatialRelationships`.

params.name: outFields
params.description: Comma-separated field list, or `*` for all fields.

params.name: returnGeometry
params.description: Include feature geometry. Setting this to false raises the per-request ceiling to `standardMaxRecordCountNoGeometry` (32,000).

params.name: outSR
params.description: Output spatial reference wkid, e.g. 4326 for WGS84.

params.name: orderByFields
params.description: Comma-separated `FIELD [ASC|DESC]` list. Layer advertises `supportsOrderBy: true`.

params.name: groupByFieldsForStatistics
params.description: Comma-separated group-by field list, used with `outStatistics`.

params.name: outStatistics
params.description: JSON array of statistic definitions. Supported statistic types include COUNT, SUM, AVG, VAR, STDDEV, MIN, MAX and the percentile family.

params.name: returnDistinctValues
params.description: Return distinct values for `outFields`. Layer advertises `supportsDistinct: true`.

params.name: returnCountOnly
params.description: Return only the matching feature count.

params.name: returnExtentOnly
params.description: Return only the extent of matching features. Layer advertises `supportsReturningQueryExtent: true`.

params.name: returnIdsOnly
params.description: Return only OBJECTIDs of matching features.

params.name: resultOffset
params.description: Zero-based offset into the result set. Layer advertises `supportsPagination: true`. Pair with `resultRecordCount` and always order by a stable field.

params.name: resultRecordCount
params.description: Page size. maxRecordCount is 1000; standardMaxRecordCount 2000; 32000 with `returnGeometry=false`.

params.name: having
params.description: SQL HAVING clause applied to grouped statistics. Layer advertises `supportsHavingClause: true`.

params.name: f
params.description: Response format. The service advertises supportedQueryFormats "JSON, geoJSON, PBF"; `html` and `pjson` are also served by ArcGIS REST.

items.docs: Query the "Hosting Capacity (KW)" layer with a SQL `where` clause, an optional spatial filter, and optional statistics. Supports pagination via `resultOffset` / `resultRecordCount` (maxRecordCount 1000; `standardMaxRecordCount` 2000, and 32000 when `returnGeometry=false`). Set `returnCountOnly=true` for a feature count, `returnDistinctValues=true` for a distinct-value list, and `f=geojson` for RFC 7946 GeoJSON.

info.name: Query hosting capacity feeder segments (form POST)

items.docs: Identical to the GET form, submitted as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. Use this when the `where` clause or geometry exceeds practical URL length. Verified anonymously on 2026-07-27.

params.name: topFilter

params.name: f

items.docs: Return the top N features within each group — for example the highest DER capacity segment per substation. The layer advertises `supportsTopFeaturesQuery: true`; a `where` clause is required in addition to `topFilter`. Verified anonymously on 2026-07-27.
